# SEG step 2 — 0.9-s2

Every crop with height > width turns 90° right before line inventory, gate, row frame, length and padding. Every h ≤ w crop follows S1 unchanged. No aspect threshold, exception, guard or detector tuning was added. Rotation and near-square results below are diagnostics only.

Local execution only; network blocked through the unchanged S1 audit hook; no OCR reader, Clariden, census write, Git write or commit. The lead commits.

The legacy `QuarterTurn.orientation_cw` helper actually follows PIL positive-counterclockwise angles: its value **270** implements the requested physical clockwise turn. Both pixel centres and the boundary-coordinate matrix are tested. The frame retains that legacy encoding so existing context consumers use the correct transform. S2 marks the owner-directed orientation resolved without consulting the orientation detector.

## Replay and owner scoring

Inputs, native adapter, predictor, context selection, timeout and scoring are reused from S1. Fresh native S1 matches all 1,288 saved S1 records (excluding only orientation elapsed `seconds`). Full stored reader answers are scored without running a reader. The 150 use the exact gate2 owner-state function: FP = DROP/fine, FN = KEEP/faulty, UNC = every UNCERTAIN. Positive fault flags take precedence over unresolved flags; crop_overrun alone is fine. The 888 uses only owner_rating.decision on the same 135 rows. Cells are scored only through explicit marks. Latest timestamp wins, with file order breaking timestamp ties; 240 entries yield 235 distinct marked IDs, all matched, scored once.

0.8 is the saved S1 native baseline (18/14/11), retained unchanged.

## Rotation check — diagnostics only

Each of the 150 crops was turned left, right and 180°, then fed AS GIVEN through the full S2 adapter, including its h > w turn. Upright means the as-given replay crop processed by S2. The main-row box is the exact AABB of components assigned by the unchanged detector to its main row, independent of gate/Stage B. Boundary corners are mapped back through both the tool frame and the external turn into the original crop coordinates. Detection agreement requires the same total row count and all four main-row-box coordinates within ±1 px; two absent main boxes agree. No tolerance is applied to the numerical measurement columns: exact agreement is reported. Both row counts and mapped boxes are saved for every crop.

To provide measurement on every orientation, the diagnostic reuses the existing feature function and predictor on the captured native detector output even if the production gate blocks. These measurements remain outside tool evidence; the saved native verdict is unchanged. Red guides are the main mean/base, blue guides are neighbours, green is the production Stage B box when available.

## Near-square 1–2-glyph diagnostic — never a threshold

Replay selection is h > w and the unchanged Google character_count ≤2, over all 1,288 cohort records. Census selection reproduces the Small segment analysis: h > w and saved census characters 1–2 over all 592,466 local evidence rows. Bins are disjoint and right-closed. Their boundaries are used only for this table.

| Population | Count | Aspect bins | S1 → S2 transitions | Flips | Explicitly marked records |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| replay | 15 | {'h<=1.25w': 8, '1.25w<h<=1.5w': 2, '1.5w<h<=2w': 5, 'h>2w': 0} | {'UNCERTAIN->UNCERTAIN': 11, 'UNCERTAIN->KEEP': 4} | 4 | 13 |
| census | 600 | {'h<=1.25w': 259, '1.25w<h<=1.5w': 152, '1.5w<h<=2w': 138, 'h>2w': 51} | {'UNCERTAIN->DROP': 66, 'UNCERTAIN->UNCERTAIN': 299, 'UNCERTAIN->KEEP': 235} | 301 | 3 |

Census population: **2540**; bins **{'1.25w<h<=1.5w': 600, 'h<=1.25w': 1170, '1.5w<h<=2w': 522, 'h>2w': 248}**. [Population receipt](census_population_receipt.json), [all 2,540 candidate records](census_candidates.jsonl). The count comes from local cells/population_cells.jsonl.gz; no census execution or modification occurred.

All 2,540 candidates had an existing crop or a frozen binding to a source page present locally. A uniform random sample without replacement, seed 20261019, was drawn from the sorted available IDs, capped at 600. All selected crop bytes, dimensions, frozen feature files and used source-page hashes were verified. Existing collect_v3 reconstructed_crop PNG encoding was reused; regenerated crops were written only under s2/census_crops. This sample is a diagnostic, not a new acceptance set. [Acquisition receipt](census_acquisition_receipt.json), [sample inputs](census_inputs.jsonl), [complete replay/census diagnostics](near_square.jsonl).

Horizontal evidence hashes are in [horizontal_readback.jsonl](horizontal_readback.jsonl). Every saved gate/final verdict and available predictor result was independently read back using the unchanged services.

- `tests/test_seg_gate.py`

Only orient_crop changes in production. line_inventory, grouping, body membership, row completeness, refocus, JS policy, row-frame geometry, length/padding rules, predictor, NativeSegmenter and all other initial files are unchanged. Tool metadata changes segmentation alone and rebuilds exactly, preserving the canonical sol-recut component namespace. The historical zero-angle deskew regression uses the saved S1 orientation because one fixture is vertical; this retains its historical arithmetic check. New S2 tests cover the exact height boundary, square non-turn, asymmetric clockwise pixel and boundary transform, and horizontal frame/raster equality. Full native replay verifies every horizontal crop.
